comment: Which stores each harness brings (the router adds them to a session; the app hides them). Sensitivity and the Fly store live in the core, not here. `tunnel` holds CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET = the Access service token jarvis2-tunnel, which the cf-tunnel Worker confines to registering Jarvis 2 session tunnels (the web UI of OpenCode/Paseo and OpenClaw; tunnel pages and drops in Claude sessions, TUNNEL_ID = the session id). openclaw runs on the Claude subscription, hence `claude`.
